battle.name: 唐滅百濟之戰
battle.brief: 唐高宗顯慶五年，唐軍以契苾何力、楊武通率步騎自北方南下，劉仁願率戰艦自萊州浮海東下，海陸兩路夾擊百濟王城熊津。弩是這場戰役的核心：攻城一方的弩陣把百濟守軍壓在牆頭，守城的弩手則居高射覆江面，663 年白江江一役唐新羅聯軍更以發火弩燒擊倭國舟隊，百濟國祚就此終結。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 唐軍與百濟之間的一場決定性戰爭，交戰方分別是唐王朝、其盟友新羅，以及百濟、高句麗與倭國聯成的聯盟。唐朝一方以唐高宗李治下詔出兵，策劃與推動由武則天（高宗元配、當時掌後宮之權）主導；前線由左驃騎大將軍契苾何力任安市道行軍大總管，統攝陸路大軍，右武衛將軍楊武通為副將，水路由劉仁願率戰艦自萊州、登州出海，兩路直取百濟王城熊津。新羅以金庾信為大將，率羅濟兵配合唐軍，並提供嚮導與糧秣協助。百濟方面以王城熊津為核心，國王扶余義慈在漢江下游諸城設防，太子扶余昌、扶余隆先後立於國主之位；遺臣餘安仕於國破之後收攏散卒、勾結倭國重建政權。倭國自四百年前便在百濟境內扶植勢力，此番由齊明天皇提議、天智皇子主持，遣將朴市田來津率舟師與兵員入援，目標是把唐軍逐出半島、恢復百濟國。整場戰爭是唐、新羅聯手對百濟、高句麗、倭國三方牽制的對決。
countriesEn: The war was fought between the Tang dynasty and its ally Silla on one side, and the coalition of Baekje, Goguryeo and Wa on the other. On the Tang side Emperor Gaozong of Tang (李治) issued the order to campaign, with the planning and the push carried out under Empress Wu Zetian (武則天); in the field Li He (契苾何力), Commander of the Ready Cavalry on the Left, was appointed Grand Commander of the Anyi Circuit (安市道行軍大總管) to direct the land army, with Yang Wutong (楊武通), Right Imperial Guards Commander, as his deputy, while Liu Renyuan (劉仁願) commanded several thousand warships that sailed east out of Laizhou and Dengzhou to strike at the Baekje capital of Ungjin. Silla fought under Kim Yuseok (金庾信), giving the Tang force local guides and supplies. Baekje defended the river fortress of Ungjin, with King Buyu Yeoji (扶余義慈) holding the lower Han River line and his sons Buyu Chang (扶余昌) and Buyu Long (扶余隆) raised in turn to the throne; after the fall of the capital the minister Yu Anshi (餘安仕) gathered the scattered remnants and rebuilt a state with the help of Wa. The court of Wa, which had been fostering a position inside Baekje for four hundred years, on this occasion saw the plan first proposed by Prince Saimei (齊明天皇) and the war directed by Prince Tenji (天智皇子), who sent the general Pak Cheol Chi-rae (朴市田來津) with a fleet and troops to intervene. The aim was to drive the Tang army off the peninsula and restore the kingdom of Baekje. The whole conflict was therefore a Tang-Silla contest against a Baekje-Goguryeo-Wa axis.
people: 唐高宗李治在顯慶五年下詔發兵，表面上是要救百濟免受高句麗攻滅，實際上接受武則天的建議，欲趁百濟虛弱一口吞掉半島西部的據點。真正主導陸路戰役的是契苾何力，這位契苾部粟特人少年時被百濟擄去，在百濟生活多年，熟悉半島的水文、道路與城防，歸唐後被視為最了解百濟的將領；他在 660 年秋率步騎自北方南下，攻破獨城、包圍熊津，是迫使百濟國王出降的關鍵人物。右武衛將軍楊武通為其副手，出身關中將門，長於籌策，攻城時與何力配合默契，日後更被授安東都護。水軍主將劉仁願率艦隊自萊州浮海，屢次接戰沿海的百濟與高句麗據點，後在白江江與新羅聯軍共破倭軍；此役之後他與契苾何力互不相容，最終因罪被除。百濟國王扶余義慈於 660 年熊津城破時被俘，其子扶余昌在唐軍控制下繼位，扶余隆被立為太子。餘安仕則是亡國之後最有組織力的反抗者，收攏潰卒、沿海襲擾，最終在追兵中伏誅。倭國方面，齊明天皇擬出兵，行至筑紫病倒，兵權轉由天智皇子執掌，朴市田來津以裹率身份率舟師及百濟、高句麗舊族同行，於白江江一戰全軍覆沒。新羅王金庾信則以本土地形為唐軍嚮路，使唐軍得以在半島站穩腳跟。
peopleEn: Emperor Gaozong of Tang (李治) ordered the expedition in the fifth year of Xianqing, ostensibly to save Baekje from destruction by Goguryeo, but in fact accepting the counsel of Empress Wu Zetian (武則天) to swallow the western strongpoints of the peninsula while Baekje was weak. The man who actually directed the land campaign was Li He (契苾何力), a Sogdian of the Cijie tribe who had been carried off to Baekje as a boy and had lived there for many years, so that he knew the waterways, roads and fortifications of the peninsula better than any other Tang officer; in the autumn of 660 he led foot and horse south from the north, broke the fortress of Dokseong (獨城) and closed on Ungjin, and it was the weight of his advance that forced the Baekje king to come out and surrender. His deputy Yang Wutong (楊武通), of a military family in the Guanzhong region, was skilled at planning and worked closely with Li He at the walls, and was afterwards made Protector General of the East (安東都護). The naval commander Liu Renyuan (劉仁願) brought his fleet down from Laizhou, engaged the coastal strongholds of Baekje and Goguryeo in turn, and afterwards fought together with the Silla army at the river mouth of Paekgang and destroyed the Wa fleet; afterwards he could not get on with Li He and was eventually put to death on a charge. King Buyu Yeoji was taken prisoner when Ungjin fell in 660; his son Buyu Chang succeeded him under Tang control, and Buyu Long was set up as crown prince. Yu Anshi (餘安仕) was the most disciplined of the resistance leaders after the fall of the kingdom, gathering the broken remnants, raiding along the coast, and was finally killed while being hunted down. On the Wa side Prince Saimei proposed the expedition and fell ill on the way to Tsukushi, leaving the war in the hands of his elder brother Prince Tenji; the general Pak Cheol Chi-rae (朴市田來津), holding the court rank of military captain, took a fleet and troops across the sea with Baekje and Goguryeo exiles among them, and was wiped out at Paekgang. Kim Yuseok (金庾信) of Silla, using his knowledge of the local terrain, served as the guide that allowed the Tang army to stand firm on the peninsula.
kits: 這張卡面是一具秦弩：弩機把拉弦的力存起來，射手不必再拉弓就能重複射擊，射速遠勝拉弓的弓箭手，這正是它作為守城器械的價值所在。唐軍進攻百濟與高句麗時，弩是壓制城頭守軍的主要手段。陸軍以蹶張弩、腰張弩為主，步兵排成齊射隊形，在城壕之外以數十張弩同時放箭，把城頭的射界覆蓋；水軍與守軍則用可固定於船舷或城堞的發火弩，把點著火的箭矢射出，專射船帆與燒毀木構。百濟守城的一方同樣倚賴弩：熊津等城牆上配置大量弩手，漢江下游水面寬闊，弓弩的射程正好壓住唐軍在江邊展開的攻城隊形與填壕士卒。與弩配合的還有角弓、鳴鏑與長槍，唐軍攻城主力是披甲步卒，持盾執刀，負責最後攀牆；百濟守軍則以石砲、撞木與短兵守住城門缺口。攻城器械方面，史料對 660 年這場戰役記載有限，可確知的是唐軍並未倚賴大型攻城塔，而以步卒近牆、弩箭掩護的正面強攻為主。全軍糧秣依海運由山東、登萊與遼東的基地供應，戰馬與輜重在半島山地的移動效率有限，許多路段改以人力與舟船轉運。倭國援軍則帶來長弓與大型帆船，其弓的射程與拋矢精度不遜唐弩，是白江江之戰中唯一能與唐軍發火弩抗衡的武器。
kitsEn: The card shows a Qin crossbow (秦弩): the lock stores the pull of the bowstring, so the archer does not have to draw again, and the rate of fire is far beyond that of a bowman; that is exactly what gives the weapon its value in the defence. When the Tang army moved against Baekje and Goguryeo, the crossbow was the principal means of suppressing the defenders on the walls. The land army worked with shoulder-drawn and waist-drawn crossbows, infantry drawn up in lines to fire in volleys outside the ditch, dozens of crossbows discharging at once so that the firing lines of the wall were smothered; the navy and the garrisons used ignition crossbows fixed to the ship's side or the parapet, shooting off arrows with fire attached, aimed at sails and wooden structures. The defenders of Baekje relied on the same weapon: the walls of Ungjin and the other fortresses were lined with crossbowmen, and the breadth of the Han River below gave the archers and crossbowmen exactly the range needed to pin down the Tang assault columns and the men filling the ditches. Combined with the crossbows were horn bows, whistling arrows and long spears. The Tang assault rested on armoured infantry carrying shields and blades, who made the final climb on the walls, while the Baekje garrison answered with stone throwers, battering beams and short weapons at the gates. As for siege machinery the sources are thin for the campaign of 660, and what can be said is that the Tang did not rely on great siege towers but on close assault by infantry under cover of crossbow fire. Supply of grain and equipment came by sea from the bases in Shandong, at Dengzhou and Lai and in Liaodong, and the movement of horses and wagons across the mountainous peninsula was inefficient, so many loads were carried by men and by boat instead. The Wa relief force brought longbows and large sailing ships; their bows matched Tang crossbows in range and in the flight of the shaft, and were the one weapon that could answer the Tang ignition crossbows at Paekgang.
tactics: 這場戰役的戰術核心是唐軍的海陸兩面夾擊與弩箭覆蓋。陸軍由契苾何力、楊武通率領，循海岸線與山間谷道南進，隊形以步騎混編，騎兵擔任警戒與追擊，步兵則是攻城的核心；每到一處山城，先以弩陣齊射驅散城頭射手，再令披甲士卒持盾近牆，弓弩手同時壓制城頭，縮短暴露的時間。水軍由劉仁願率數千艘戰艦自萊州、登州出海，順風二十餘日抵達熊津口，封鎖江口，斷絕百濟王城與沿海諸城的聯繫；船隊同時沿海岸奪取外縣、招降沿海城堡，形成由海向陸的包圍。百濟的守禦依托漢江下游的水障與山城：弩手居高臨下封鎖江面，弓弩在城頭排成密集的射擊線，逼唐軍攻城者只能在盾後接近；守軍不輕易出城野戰，以免離開城牆的保護。百濟亡國後，餘安仕以殘兵收攏潰散據點，轉向游擊與襲擾，專打唐軍薄弱的分屯據點，並遣使向倭國求援。663 年的白江江之戰是整場戰爭的收尾：唐軍與新羅聯軍先佔據上游、居高臨下，倭軍舟隊密集結隊溯流而上，聯軍趁順風以弩火齊射、火船衝撞，倭軍陣形一亂即當場崩潰。補給上，唐軍依賴海運，山東、登萊與遼東的基地必須維持糧道，一度因缺糧而屢請增兵。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the campaign was the Tang pincer from sea and land and the blanket of crossbow fire that went with it. The land army under Li He and Yang Wutong advanced south along the coast and through the valleys, mixing foot and horse, with the cavalry scouting and pursuing while the infantry did the work of the assault; before each hill town they first fired a volley of crossbows to drive the defenders off the parapet, then sent armoured men forward behind their shields to close on the wall, while the archers and crossbowmen held the defenders down so that the time of exposure was cut short. The fleet of several thousand warships under Liu Renyuan sailed out of Laizhou and Dengzhou, reached the mouth of the Ungjin River in about twenty days on a fair wind, closed the river mouth and cut the capital off from the coastal towns; at the same time the ships seized the outer districts and took the coastal fortresses by surrender, so that the net closed from the sea towards the land. Baekje's defence rested on the water barrier of the lower Han River and on hill forts: crossbowmen on high ground sealed the river surface, and the bows and crossbows on the walls were drawn up in dense firing lines that forced the Tang assault troops to approach only behind their shields, and the garrison was reluctant to leave the walls for a set-piece battle in the open. After the fall of the state, Yu Anshi gathered the broken remnants into strongpoints and turned to raiding, striking at the thin detachments and isolated garrisons of the Tang and sending envoys to Wa for help. The battle at the river mouth of Paekgang in 663 closed the whole war: the Tang-Silla army took the upper water first and looked down on the Wa fleet, which had closed up in a dense formation and pushed up the river, and the allies used the fair wind to loose a barrage of fire-arrows and to send fire ships down the current; the Wa formation broke on the spot. In logistics the Tang depended entirely on the sea, and the bases in Shandong, at Dengzhou and Lai and in Liaodong had to keep the grain route open; at one point the supply ran short and reinforcements were requested again and again.
data: 關於兵力，史料記載互相矛盾，只能取其概數。《資治通鑑》記唐軍陸路出動步騎十餘萬，這是詔令下達時的總數，實際投入攻城序列者遠少於此；水軍方面記戰艦數千艘，由萊州出海至熊津口，順風航行約二十餘日。唐軍的戰役節奏在 660 年秋季展開：先克獨城，再進逼熊津，王城在同年秋末冬初陷落，國王被俘。百濟方面的守軍人數沒有可靠記載，可確定的是其城防以漢江下游的據點為核心，防禦縱深有限，一旦王城失守便無可退之地。糧秣方面，唐軍出海後依賴山東與登萊基地的船運補給，向內陸推進一段之後曾出現運糧吃緊、屢請增兵的情況；663 年白江江之戰時，唐新羅聯軍出動兵力一般認為在萬餘人規模，部分記載為一萬三千人左右。倭國方面的數字則互有出入，《日本書紀》一系有五千與數萬的不同說法，可以確定的是倭軍在舟船上的展開密度高，一旦火攻得逞就難以疏散。白江江一役，聯軍火攻得順風之便，倭軍落海與被俘者以萬計的說法出自史書記載。時間上，自 660 年出兵到 663 年底倭軍退回、餘安仕勢力被清剿完畢，前後約三年。
dataEn: On numbers the sources contradict one another, so only rough magnitudes can be given. The Zizhi Tongjian records that the Tang land force set out with more than a hundred thousand foot and horse; that was the total ordered when the decree was issued, and the number actually committed to the siege was far smaller. On the naval side the same account records several thousand warships, sailing from Laizhou to the mouth of the Ungjin River in roughly twenty days on a fair wind. The rhythm of the campaign opened in the autumn of 660: the fortress of Dokseong was taken first, the army then closed on Ungjin, and the capital fell at the turn of autumn and winter, the king being taken prisoner. No reliable figure survives for the size of the Baekje garrisons; what can be said is that their defence turned on the strongpoints of the lower Han River, that the depth of the defence was shallow, and that once the capital fell there was nowhere to fall back to. As to supply, the Tang army depended on shipping the grain from the bases in Shandong and at Dengzhou, and after pushing inland it came under strain and asked for more troops several times. At the battle of Paekgang in 663 the Tang-Silla force is generally put at a little over ten thousand, some accounts giving about thirteen thousand. The Japanese figures differ, the Nihon Shoki giving both five thousand and several tens of thousands, and what is certain is that the density of the Wa order of battle on the boats was high and that once the fire took hold there was no way to disperse it. In that battle the allies had the wind, and the accounts that tens of thousands of the Wa were lost in the water or taken prisoner rest on the historical record. As to time, from the order to march in 660 to the withdrawal of the Wa and the final destruction of Yu Anshi's movement at the end of 663, the whole business took about three years.
cause: 起火點在半島三國的長期角力與唐、羅之間的特殊關係。百濟自四世紀以來長期侵奪高句麗南部與新羅北部，與高句麗形成拉鋸；同時百濟在倭國深入時得到大量兵員與物資支援，倭國自四世紀末起便在百濟扶植代理人，形成倭將百濟的格局，唐朝視之為對東北亞秩序的挑戰。645 年唐太宗大舉攻擊高句麗無功而返，留下的詔令要求高句麗、百濟朝貢，這份盟約成為此後雙方角力的法律基礎。653 年百濟遣使進獻熊膽並請求送還被擄去的新羅、倭國人，654 年前後其使節再度入唐，與唐的關係一度緩和；但 655 年高句麗大破百濟十餘城，扶余義慈兵敗求救於唐。唐高宗與武則天抓住了這個機會：出兵名義上是救援，實際上要藉百濟求援之際切斷高句麗的西南翼，統一朝鮮半島的西部，並消滅百濟對新羅的壓迫。新羅則積極推動出兵，因為只有借唐軍之力才能同時對付高句麗與百濟，完成三國統一。新羅的請兵、倭國的介入與百濟的求援，三方拉扯之下，才有了 660 年這場戰爭。
causeEn: The spark was the long struggle of the three kingdoms of the peninsula and the peculiar relationship between Tang and Silla. Since the fourth century Baekje had been pressing into southern Goguryeo and northern Silla in a long war of attrition against Goguryeo, and at the same time it received large numbers of men and supplies from Wa, which had been fostering a client regime inside Baekje since the end of the fourth century; the arrangement of a Wa ruler in Baekje was treated by the Tang as a challenge to the order of Northeast Asia. The great expedition of Emperor Taizong against Goguryeo in 645 ended without victory, and the edict left behind required both Goguryeo and Baekje to pay court; that undertaking became the legal basis of the tug of war that followed. In 653 Baekje sent an embassy with bear gall as tribute and asked for the return of Silla and Wa captives; around 654 another envoy came to the Tang court and relations briefly improved. But in 655 Goguryeo broke more than ten cities of Baekje, and King Buyu Yeoji, defeated, turned to the Tang for help. Emperor Gaozong and Empress Wu seized the opening: the expedition was justified as a rescue, but its real purpose was to cut away the southwestern flank of Goguryeo, to unify the western half of the Korean peninsula, and to remove the pressure that Baekje had kept on Silla. Silla actively pressed for the expedition, for only Tang strength allowed her to fight Goguryeo and Baekje at once and to complete the unification of the three kingdoms. Silla's request for help, Wa's intervention and Baekje's appeal were all pulling at once, and out of that three-way tension the war of 660 was born.
impact: 這一戰的後果遠超半島本身。百濟作為獨立王國在 660 年終結，此後其領土先由唐朝設置的安東都護府系統代管，戶口與兵員被分編、徙置內地，數萬名百濟俘戶與降人被重新編入唐軍體系，成為唐在東北亞軍事機器的一部分，而百濟王族則淪為流亡的附庸，扶余昌與扶余隆在異域終老。對新羅而言，最大的障礙瞬間消失，新羅得以趁勢回到三國一統的目標，但同時也被唐軍直接接管了半島南部。對唐朝而言，佔領百濟並不等於長期收益：羈縻體系需要大量軍費與官員，跨海運輸的糧道極不穩定，與新羅的關係也因分地而產生嫌隙，最終 668 年滅高句麗、於其地置都督府與安東都護府之後，唐朝在 669 年主動放棄百濟的直轄，把土地交還新羅，換取半島南端的安寧。對倭國而言，這是自四世紀以來第一次在海外的正面軍事挫敗，白江江一敗之後，倭國放棄了在百濟的代理人與據點，把與大陸交往的門戶讓給了新羅，遣隋使、遣唐使的航線也隨之改道。百濟亡國之後，渤海、高句麗遺民與新羅三方在半島與東北亞的競爭格局延續了數百年。
impactEn: The consequences reached far beyond the peninsula. Baekje ceased to exist as an independent kingdom in 660; its territory was at first administered by the Tang apparatus of the Protector General of the East, its households and soldiers were enrolled and moved inland, tens of thousands of Baekje prisoners and surrendered people were taken into the Tang military system and became part of the Tang war machine in Northeast Asia, while the royal house was reduced to an exile and a client, Buyu Chang and Buyu Long ending their days far from home. For Silla the largest obstacle disappeared at a stroke, and it could return to the goal of uniting the three kingdoms, but at the same time it found the southern peninsula taken over directly by the Tang. For the Tang, holding Baekje was not the same as long-term gain: the garrison system demanded heavy revenue and officials, the sea route that carried the grain was highly unstable, and the division of the territory sowed friction with Silla. So after destroying Goguryeo in 668 and setting up commanderies and the Protector General of the East over it, the Tang handed Baekje over to Silla in 669 and withdrew from direct rule there, in exchange for quiet at the southern end of the peninsula. For Wa this was the first outright military defeat abroad since the fourth century; after the loss at the river mouth, the Wa abandoned their clients and footholds in Baekje, left the gateway to the continent to Silla, and the sea routes of the envoys to Sui and Tang shifted with it. After the fall of Baekje the competition among Balhae, the Goguryeo remnant and Silla over the peninsula and Northeast Asia continued for centuries.
result: 結果是百濟國祚斷絕。660 年秋，契苾何力、楊武通部攻破獨城，進軍熊津，百濟國王扶余義慈出降被俘，太子扶余昌在唐軍控制下繼位，唐軍留劉仁願等屯守要地，主力班師。表面上百濟仍以傀儡國的形式存在於記錄裡，實際的兵權與政權都在唐軍與新羅手中。663 年，遺臣餘安仕聚兵復國，攻陷部分城邑，得到倭國出兵援助；八月白江江一戰，唐軍與新羅聯軍以弩火與火船大破倭軍舟隊，倭軍退回日本，餘安仕的勢力隨之瓦解，部分首領被斬或被俘後送長安。百濟復國的希望至此完全破滅，餘下的王室成員有的流亡高句麗與唐朝，有的淪為新羅的俘虜。此後數年，唐朝依賴百濟據點大舉攻擊高句麗，668 年平壤陷落，於其地置都督府與安東都護府；669 年百濟地區交由新羅接管，唐朝自半島南部撤出。百濟作為王國從此退出歷史舞台，但它的王族、臣民與軍隊被唐、新羅、倭三方面瓜分，成為之後東亞格局的底層素材。
resultEn: The outcome was the end of the Baekje state. In the autumn of 660 the forces of Li He and Yang Wutong broke through Dokseong, advanced on Ungjin, and King Buyu Yeoji came out to surrender and was taken prisoner; the crown prince Buyu Chang was installed as king under Tang control, the Tang left Liu Renyuan and others to garrison the key towns and sent the main body home. In the record Baekje still existed as a puppet, but the arms and the government were in the hands of the Tang and of Silla. In 663 Yu Anshi rallied troops to restore the kingdom, seized a number of towns, and obtained aid from Wa; in August, at the battle of the river mouth of Paekgang, the Tang-Silla army broke the Wa fleet with fire-arrows and fire ships, the Wa withdrew to Japan, and with them Yu Anshi's movement collapsed, some of its leaders being killed and others captured and sent to Chang'an. Every hope of restoring Baekje was thereby extinguished: some of the remaining royal members fled to Goguryeo or to Tang territory, others became prisoners of Silla. In the years that followed the Tang used the Baekje bases to strike hard at Goguryeo; Pyongyang fell in 668, and commanderies and the Protector General of the East were set up over it. In 669 the Baekje district was handed over to Silla and the Tang withdrew from the southern peninsula. Baekje as a kingdom left the stage of history for good, but its royal house, its people and its army were divided among Tang, Silla and Wa, and became the stock from which the later East Asian order was built.
